name: protos-codegen-tools
description: Dev-only tooling to generate gen/ts TypeScript bindings via buf. Not published.

comments.pinning: Exact versions, no carets: package-lock.json is gitignored, so a caret range would let npm resolve a newer protoc-gen-es and silently change gen/ts, failing the generated-code-is-current check on an unrelated PR. Bump deliberately, committing the regenerated gen/ts in the same PR.
